text: Ten fictional nonprofit programme passages, each with eight quote variants for citation-checker testing.

passages.source_passage: At the midpoint of the Sundarpur Mothers First project, outreach teams from the Kalindi Health Collective had visited 42 villages across Ranganadi district. Between January 2022 and June 2023, community health workers registered 3,180 pregnant women, and 68% of them attended at least four antenatal check-ups. Facility births rose from roughly one in three to nearly two in three over the same period. However, the evaluation team found that postnatal visits within 48 hours were not consistently recorded in the clinic logbooks. Several outreach nurses said they had never received the revised reporting forms. The evaluators recommend that the project hire two additional data assistants before the second phase begins in March 2024.

passages.source_passage: This monitoring report covers the third quarter of the Open Doors Mobility Project run by the Tarvel Access Trust in Mennick County. During July to September 2024, the project distributed 214 wheelchairs, 96 hearing aids and eleven sets of adapted crutches to registered beneficiaries. Field officers carried out follow-up visits to 80% of recipients within six weeks of delivery. Ramp construction at public buildings fell behind schedule, and only three of the planned nine ramps were finished. The district council did not approve the remaining building permits until late September. Beneficiaries told monitors that the new ramps at the Mennick market hall had made weekly shopping far easier. No device returns were reported for faulty parts during the quarter.

passages.source_passage: Volunteers in the Puente Alto Scholars programme, run by Fundación Caracol Verde in the hill towns of Valle Serrano, should read this section before their first home visit. Each scholarship covers tuition, two school uniforms and a monthly bus stipend of 40 dollars. In 2023, 126 girls held scholarships, and 91% completed the school year. When you meet a family, explain that the stipend is paid directly to the student's mentor, not to the parents. Do not promise extra support for siblings, because the programme cannot fund them. Always ask the girl herself which subjects she finds hardest, and record her answer on the visit sheet.

passages.source_passage: Thanks to your continued support, the Little Steps Playgroup Network expanded from 18 to 27 neighbourhood playgroups across Hollinbrook and Wetherby Vale during 2023. Trained parent facilitators ran sessions three mornings a week, reaching 640 children aged two to five. Developmental screening at the start and end of the year showed that 72% of children met or exceeded age milestones in language, up from 55% in 2022. We did not reach our target of opening a playgroup in the Eastmoor estate, as no suitable venue was available. Parents consistently told us that the sessions helped their children settle into primary school. In 2024 we plan to train 30 new facilitators and pilot a fathers' Saturday group.

passages.source_passage: This module prepares volunteers to support new savings groups in the Kiboro Hills under the Mwangaza Savings Partnership. Each group should have between 15 and 25 members, who meet weekly and buy shares worth 200 shillings each. The cash box must have three padlocks, and the three keyholders should never be members of the same household. Loans can be taken out after the first 12 weeks of saving, with a service charge of 10% per month. Do not handle members' money yourself at any point; your role is to observe and coach. At the end of each 12-month cycle, savings and profits are shared out in proportion to the shares each member bought.

passages.source_passage: Board members will recall that the Dryland Seeds Initiative began planting trials in Okavu and Lesemi districts in October 2023. By the end of the long rains, 1,450 households had planted the new short-season sorghum, against a target of 1,200. Average yields on trial plots were 38% higher than on neighbouring plots using local varieties, despite rainfall that was well below normal. The cowpea trial was less successful and did not produce enough seed for redistribution. Staff also report that the community seed bank in Lesemi wasn't completed because cement deliveries were delayed by six weeks. Management requests that the board approve a revised budget of 84,000 dollars for the 2025 season.

passages.source_passage: As a field school facilitator with the Green Furrow Farmers Network in Ashvale, you will guide a group of about 25 farmers through one full growing season. Sessions take place every two weeks on a shared demonstration plot, divided into two halves. On one half farmers follow their usual practices; on the other they test the improved methods introduced in this guide. Never tell farmers which half will perform better. Instead, ask them to record plant height, pest counts and soil moisture on the observation sheet at every visit. Experienced farmers should mentor new members during field walks. In last year's cycle, 63% of participants adopted mulching on their own farms afterwards. Facilitators should not apply fertiliser to the demonstration plot without the group's agreement.

passages.source_passage: Volunteers with the Saltmere Coast Alert Programme are the first link between the regional forecasting office and households in the 14 fishing villages we serve. When a cyclone warning is issued, you have no more than 90 minutes to complete your assigned door-to-door round. Use the red flag for a level-three warning and the black flag only when evacuation is ordered. Do not spread warnings you have heard on social media; wait for confirmation by radio from the village coordinator. During the drill in May 2024, volunteers reached 88% of households within the time limit. Elderly residents living alone must be visited first, and you should note their names on the priority list.

passages.source_passage: In 2024 the Clearspring Rural Water Fund completed 19 new boreholes in the Nadu Plateau, bringing safe water within 500 metres of an estimated 7,600 people. Each borehole is managed by an elected water committee, at least half of whose members are women. Households also built 410 latrines with materials subsidised by the project, and four villages were certified open-defecation free. Water quality tests in October found no E. coli contamination at any of the new sites. However, two older boreholes at Kemba and Lowan were not repaired in time because replacement pumps arrived late. Average daily water collection time for women fell from two hours to around 35 minutes.

passages.source_passage: Welcome to the Lantern Hours evening literacy network, which runs classes in 32 community halls across Brackenford and the Tollin valley. Each class meets twice a week for 90 minutes, and no group should have more than 20 learners. Many of our learners left school before the age of ten, and some have never held a pencil. Begin every session by reviewing the words learned the week before, then introduce no more than five new words. Learners, not tutors, should choose the reading topics each month. Last year, 74% of learners who attended regularly could read a simple notice by the end of the course. Do not correct spelling in front of the whole group.
